def comb_sort(lst):
    gap = len(lst)
    shrink_factor = 1.3  # common shrink factor for comb sort
    sorted_lst = lst.copy()  # make a copy of the original list
    swapped = True  # flag to check if any swap has happened

    while gap > 1 or swapped:
        gap = max(1, int(gap / shrink_factor))
        swapped = False
        for i in range(len(lst) - gap):
            j = i + gap
            if sorted_lst[i] > sorted_lst[j]:

                swapped = True

    return sorted_lst
